reading.title: Many Ways to Move
reading.purpose: Learn the exact words for how people and animals move.
paras: People and animals move in many ways. A swan can glide across a pond. A cat can creep low to the ground.
A rabbit can dash across the grass. You can tiptoe past a sleeping baby. If you stumble, you may tumble. Then you get up and try again!

qs.why: You tiptoe past a sleeping baby so you stay quiet.

qs.q: Which animal can glide across a pond?
qs.why: The reading says a swan can glide across a pond.

qs.q: Why might you tiptoe past a sleeping baby?
qs.why: Tiptoeing is quiet, so the baby can keep sleeping.
